messages.subject: Get wrong result when doing a mr job
parts:
Hi all,

I am new to Hadoop, and RHadoop as well.
(Before RHadoop, I only had experience using Hadoop streaming to run some simple map/reduce jobs in python.)

And now I'm practicing using RHadoop to do a really simple job: read data in, use fields[1] as key and fields[3] as value in map function. That's it.(even no reduce phase)
I am using Hadoop 1.0.4, and rmr2 3.0.0.
The process seems fine, but I only get partial result.(not all of them)
(It should have showed all records)


Here's my  R code:
map <- function(k,v) {
    fields <- unlist(strsplit(v, ","))
    kv_map = keyval(fields[1],fields[3])
    rmr.str(kv_map)
    return(kv_map)
}
mapreduce(
  input = "test_stock.txt",
  input.format = "text",
  map = map,  
)

messages.author: 6ac7e7dfbe4f6c38
messages.subject: Re: [RHadoop:#1317] Get wrong result when doing a mr job
parts:
fields <- unlist(strsplit(v, ","))
    kv_map = keyval(fields[1],fields[3])

These two lines parse only the first line and discard the rest. Why not use

input.format = make.input.format("csv", sep = ",")

Then v is a data frame and you just return

keyval(v[,1], v[,3])

Plus you are not using any of the debugging possibilities. Absolutely run this on the local backend with a local file. Enter debug(map). Run. There's a whole debugging guide on the wiki. Don't make your life more difficult than it has to be.


Antonio

splitstr gives you list() format. If you unlist it, it will become a vector. 
Once you use field[1] and field[3], you will only get the first and third element of that vector. 

here is I will do:

    field<-splitstr(v, ",")
   keyval(sapply(field, "[", 1), sapply(field, "]", 3)
}
from.dfs(mapreduce(input="test_stock.txt", input.format="text", map=map.stock))
